examples.en: Nobody can predict the future.
examples.uz: Hech kim kelajakni bashorat qila olmaydi.

examples.en: Several people had predicted this, and all of them were ignored.
examples.uz: Bir necha kishi buni bashorat qilgandi va ularning hammasi eʼtiborsiz qoldirildi.

examples.en: Her heart was beating fast.
examples.uz: Uning yuragi tez urardi.

examples.en: She knew the route by heart and still took the wrong turning.
examples.uz: U yoʻlni yoddan bilardi va baribir notoʻgʻri burildi.

examples.en: Learning a language is a long process.
examples.uz: Til oʻrganish uzoq jarayon.

examples.en: The process takes six weeks, of which five are waiting.
examples.uz: Jarayon olti hafta oladi, shundan beshtasi kutish bilan oʻtadi.

examples.en: Secondly, we need more time.
examples.uz: Ikkinchidan, bizga koʻproq vaqt kerak.

examples.en: Secondly, nobody has explained who is paying for all this.
examples.uz: Ikkinchidan, bularning hammasiga kim toʻlashini hech kim tushuntirmagan.

examples.en: I'm under a lot of stress at work.
examples.uz: Men ishda katta stress ostidaman.

examples.en: He'd been under stress for so long that he no longer noticed it.
examples.uz: U shunchalik uzoq stress ostida boʻldiki, endi buni sezmay qoʻygandi.

examples.en: I have an electric car.
examples.uz: Mening elektr mashinam bor.

examples.en: Electric cars are cheaper to run and harder to repair.
examples.uz: Elektr mashinalarni ishlatish arzonroq, taʼmirlash esa qiyinroq.

examples.en: Can I have a clean towel?
examples.uz: Menga toza sochiq bera olasizmi?

examples.en: There was one towel for four people and nobody complained.
examples.uz: Toʻrt kishiga bitta sochiq bor edi va hech kim shikoyat qilmadi.

examples.en: Fish and chips, please.
examples.uz: Iltimos, baliq va kartoshka fri.

examples.en: The chips were cold by the time the fish arrived.
examples.uz: Baliq kelganida kartoshka fri sovib qolgandi.

examples.en: Did you manage to find the hotel?
examples.uz: Mehmonxonani topa oldingizmi?

examples.en: Somehow they managed to finish on time without any extra help.
examples.uz: Ular qandaydir yoʻl bilan qoʻshimcha yordamsiz oʻz vaqtida tugatishni uddalashdi.

examples.en: We wear a uniform at school.
examples.uz: Biz maktabda forma kiyamiz.

examples.en: The uniform was changed twice in five years at considerable expense.
examples.uz: Forma besh yilda ikki marta, anchagina xarajat bilan oʻzgartirildi.

examples.en: That's a very original idea.
examples.uz: Bu juda oʻziga xos gʻoya.

examples.en: The original plan was better, and nobody can remember why it changed.
examples.uz: Dastlabki reja yaxshiroq edi va nega oʻzgartirilganini hech kim eslay olmaydi.

examples.en: The wind is very strong today.
examples.uz: Bugun shamol juda kuchli.

examples.en: The wind had been strong enough overnight to take down three trees.
examples.uz: Shamol tun boʻyi uchta daraxtni agʻdaradigan darajada kuchli boʻlgandi.

examples.en: I didn't realize it was so late.
examples.uz: Men bunchalik kech boʻlganini anglamabman.

examples.en: It was only afterwards that I realized what she'd meant.
examples.uz: Men u nimani nazarda tutganini faqat keyin angladim.

examples.en: We need to find a solution.
examples.uz: Biz yechim topishimiz kerak.

examples.en: Every solution they proposed created two new problems.
examples.uz: Ular taklif qilgan har bir yechim ikkita yangi muammo tugʻdirdi.

examples.en: Let's go for a ride.
examples.uz: Keling, sayrga chiqamiz.

examples.en: It's a long ride, and the road is worse than the map suggests.
examples.uz: Bu uzoq yoʻl va yoʻl xaritada koʻringanidan yomonroq.

examples.en: It was a scary film.
examples.uz: Bu qoʻrqinchli film edi.

examples.en: The scary part is how easily it could happen again.
examples.uz: Eng qoʻrqinchlisi — bu yana qanchalik oson takrorlanishi mumkinligi.

examples.en: He walked towards the door.
examples.uz: U eshik tomon yurdi.

examples.en: Attitudes towards the project have changed completely since spring.
examples.uz: Loyihaga boʻlgan munosabat bahordan beri butunlay oʻzgardi.

examples.en: My grandfather was a soldier.
examples.uz: Bobom askar boʻlgan.

examples.en: The soldiers who built this road were never paid for it.
examples.uz: Bu yoʻlni qurgan askarlarga hech qachon haq toʻlanmagan.

examples.en: I sleep very little.
examples.uz: Men juda kam uxlayman.

examples.en: He spoke little and noticed everything.
examples.uz: U kam gapirardi va hamma narsani sezardi.

examples.en: The wind is blowing hard.
examples.uz: Shamol qattiq esyapti.

examples.en: The wind had been blowing from the north all week.
examples.uz: Shamol butun hafta shimoldan esgandi.

examples.en: I have maths on Monday.
examples.uz: Dushanba kuni matematikam bor.

examples.en: He'd been afraid of maths since a teacher humiliated him at nine.
examples.uz: U toʻqqiz yoshida oʻqituvchi uni kamsitganidan beri matematikadan qoʻrqardi.

examples.en: The upstairs bedroom is mine.
examples.uz: Tepadagi yotoqxona meniki.

examples.en: The upstairs rooms had been shut up for years.
examples.uz: Tepadagi xonalar yillar davomida yopiq turgandi.

examples.en: Give me a chance.
examples.uz: Menga imkoniyat bering.

examples.en: There's a good chance they'll say no, and we should plan for that.
examples.uz: Ular yoʻq deyishi ehtimoli katta va biz shunga tayyorlanishimiz kerak.

examples.en: I promise I'll call you.
examples.uz: Sizga qoʻngʻiroq qilishga vaʼda beraman.

examples.en: They'd promised an answer within a week and took four months.
examples.uz: Ular bir hafta ichida javob berishga vaʼda bergandi va toʻrt oy oldi.

examples.en: What's that noise?
examples.uz: Bu qanday shovqin?

examples.en: There's been a lot of noise about this and very little action.
examples.uz: Bu haqda koʻp shovqin boʻldi va juda kam harakat.

examples.en: He gave a speech at the wedding.
examples.uz: U toʻyda nutq soʻzladi.

examples.en: The speech was written by someone who had never met him.
examples.uz: Nutqni uni hech qachon koʻrmagan odam yozgandi.

examples.en: The United Kingdom has four countries.
examples.uz: Birlashgan Qirollikda toʻrtta mamlakat bor.

examples.en: The team was united right up until the money had to be divided.
examples.uz: Jamoa pulni boʻlish kerak boʻlgunicha birlashgan edi.

examples.en: Someone stole my bike.
examples.uz: Kimdir velosipedimni oʻgʻirladi.

examples.en: Nothing was stolen, which made the break-in stranger still.
examples.uz: Hech narsa oʻgʻirlanmagandi, bu esa uyga kirishni yanada gʻalati qilardi.

examples.en: She plays the main role.
examples.uz: U bosh rolni oʻynaydi.

examples.en: Her role was never clearly defined, which suited everyone but her.
examples.uz: Uning roli hech qachon aniq belgilanmagandi, bu undan boshqa hammaga qulay edi.

examples.en: Farming is hard work.
examples.uz: Dehqonchilik ogʻir mehnat.

examples.en: Farming here depends entirely on a river that is getting smaller.
examples.uz: Bu yerda dehqonchilik butunlay kichrayib borayotgan daryoga bogʻliq.

examples.en: Answer the following questions.
examples.uz: Quyidagi savollarga javob bering.

examples.en: The following morning everyone behaved as though nothing had happened.
examples.uz: Ertasi tongda hamma hech narsa boʻlmagandek tutdi oʻzini.

examples.en: Perhaps he forgot.
examples.uz: Balki u unutgandir.

examples.en: Perhaps they were right, though it didn't feel like it at the time.
examples.uz: Balki ular haq boʻlgandir, garchi oʻshanda shunday tuyulmagan boʻlsa ham.

examples.en: He loves jazz music.
examples.uz: U jaz musiqasini yaxshi koʻradi.

examples.en: He discovered jazz late and spent the rest of his life catching up.
examples.uz: U jazni kech kashf qildi va umrining qolganini uni oʻrganishga sarfladi.

examples.en: This soup smells great.
examples.uz: Bu shoʻrvaning hidi zoʻr.

examples.en: The whole house smelled of bread for the rest of the day.
examples.uz: Butun uy kunning oxirigacha non hidi taratib turdi.

examples.en: We live in a small community.
examples.uz: Biz kichik jamoada yashaymiz.

examples.en: The community raised the money itself after the council refused.
examples.uz: Kengash rad etgandan keyin mahalla pulni oʻzi toʻpladi.

examples.en: My shoulder hurts.
examples.uz: Yelkam ogʻriyapti.

examples.en: He'd been carrying that responsibility on his own shoulders for years.
examples.uz: U bu masʼuliyatni yillar davomida oʻz yelkasida koʻtarib yurgandi.

examples.en: I'm considering a new job.
examples.uz: Men yangi ish haqida oʻylab koʻryapman.

examples.en: They considered the proposal for six months and then rejected it.
examples.uz: Ular taklifni olti oy koʻrib chiqishdi va keyin rad etishdi.

examples.en: I'm scared of the dark.
examples.uz: Men qorongʻilikdan qoʻrqaman.

examples.en: People were too scared of being wrong to say anything at all.
examples.uz: Odamlar xato qilishdan shunchalik qoʻrqishardiki, umuman hech narsa demasdi.

examples.en: You have no choice.
examples.uz: Sizda tanlov yoʻq.

examples.en: We were given a choice between bad and worse.
examples.uz: Bizga yomon bilan battar orasida tanlov berildi.

examples.en: I have a bad memory for names.
examples.uz: Mening ismlarga xotiram yomon.

examples.en: My memory of that year is better than the photographs suggest.
examples.uz: Oʻsha yil haqidagi xotiram suratlar koʻrsatganidan yaxshiroq.

examples.en: He refused to help me.
examples.uz: U menga yordam berishdan bosh tortdi.

examples.en: She refused to sign until the conditions were put in writing.
examples.uz: U shartlar yozma rasmiylashtirilmaguncha imzolashdan bosh tortdi.

examples.en: The service in this hotel is excellent.
examples.uz: Bu mehmonxonada xizmat koʻrsatish aʼlo darajada.

examples.en: The service got worse every year while the price went up.
examples.uz: Narx koʻtarilgani sari xizmat koʻrsatish har yili yomonlashdi.

examples.en: Go straight on.
examples.uz: Toʻgʻriga yuring.

examples.en: I'd rather you told me straight than softened it.
examples.uz: Yumshatgandan koʻra menga toʻgʻridan-toʻgʻri aytganingizni afzal koʻraman.

examples.en: It was such a nice day!
examples.uz: Kun shunday yaxshi boʻldi!

examples.en: There's no such thing as a decision that costs nothing.
examples.uz: Hech narsaga tushmaydigan qaror degan narsa yoʻq.

examples.en: Technology changes very fast.
examples.uz: Texnologiya juda tez oʻzgaradi.

examples.en: The technology has existed for years; the will to use it hasn't.
examples.uz: Texnologiya yillardan beri mavjud; undan foydalanish irodasi esa yoʻq.

examples.en: I'll definitely come.
examples.uz: Men albatta kelaman.

examples.en: Something definitely changed after that meeting, though nobody said what.
examples.uz: Oʻsha yigʻilishdan keyin nimadir aniq oʻzgardi, garchi buni hech kim aytmagan boʻlsa ham.

examples.en: My back hurts.
examples.uz: Belim ogʻriyapti.

examples.en: What hurt most was that nobody had thought to tell her.
examples.uz: Eng ogʻrigani — unga aytish hech kimning xayoliga kelmagani edi.

examples.en: Almost everyone has a smartphone.
examples.uz: Deyarli hammada smartfon bor.

examples.en: The smartphone has replaced about nine things that used to sit on this desk.
examples.uz: Smartfon ilgari shu stolda turgan toʻqqizta narsani almashtirdi.

examples.en: One page is missing.
examples.uz: Bir sahifa yetishmayapti.

examples.en: The missing page turned out to be the only one that mattered.
examples.uz: Yetishmayotgan sahifa yagona muhim sahifa boʻlib chiqdi.

examples.en: The car engine is very loud.
examples.uz: Mashinaning dvigateli juda shovqinli.

examples.en: The engine had been making the noise for weeks before it failed.
examples.uz: Dvigatel ishdan chiqishidan oldin haftalar davomida shovqin chiqarib yurgandi.

examples.en: The market has a variety of fruit.
examples.uz: Bozorda meva xilma-xil.

examples.en: The variety on offer is wide and the quality is not.
examples.uz: Taklif xilma-xil, sifat esa yoʻq.

examples.en: Raise your hand if you know the answer.
examples.uz: Javobni bilsangiz, qoʻlingizni koʻtaring.

examples.en: Nobody raised the obvious objection until it was far too late.
examples.uz: Juda kech boʻlgunicha hech kim koʻzga tashlanadigan eʼtirozni koʻtarmadi.

examples.en: You need permission to enter.
examples.uz: Kirish uchun ruxsat kerak.

examples.en: They started work without permission and asked for it afterwards.
examples.uz: Ular ruxsatsiz ishni boshlashdi va keyin ruxsat soʻrashdi.

examples.en: They have a huge garden.
examples.uz: Ularning juda katta bogʻi bor.

examples.en: There's a huge difference between being busy and being useful.
examples.uz: Band boʻlish bilan foydali boʻlish oʻrtasida bahaybat farq bor.

examples.en: Put the cake in the oven.
examples.uz: Tortni duxovkaga qoʻying.

examples.en: The oven runs hot, so everything takes less time than the recipe says.
examples.uz: Duxovka qizdirib yuboradi, shuning uchun hamma narsa retseptdagidan kam vaqt oladi.
